_comment: Corrections to data/ (never edited by hand): values the 5e-database snapshot has wrong or lacks against the SRD 5.1's own text and tables. The loader applies them over the class table rows (corrections), over a creature's stat block (creature_corrections), over a spell's attack, saving throw and damage table (spell_corrections) over the spells a subclass always has (subclass_corrections) and over the subclasses whose spells only join the class list (expanded_list_corrections); it refuses an unknown class, creature, spell, subclass, field or level, a value that does not fit its field, and a correction without a source. A spell correction's damage replaces the spell's whole damage table, and its damage_choice ("scale" or "alternative") says what the caster picks among the damage types; a spell with a damage table and no saving throw records the dice for display and for the master, and rolls nothing at cast.

corrections.source: SRD 5.1, Warlock table, Invocations Known: 1 none, 2-4 two, 5-6 three, 7-8 four, 9-11 five, 12-14 six, 15-17 seven, 18-20 eight (the snapshot has 3 at level 4 and 4 at level 6)

spell_corrections.source: SRD 5.1, Scorching Ray: make a ranged spell attack for each ray (the snapshot has no attack type)
SRD 5.1, Flame Blade: a melee spell attack with the fiery blade (the snapshot has no attack type)
SRD 5.1, Arcane Hand: the clenched fist is a melee spell attack for 4d8 force, +2d8 for each slot level above 5th (the grasping hand's 2d6 + modifier is not a table row: it needs a grapple first)
SRD 5.1, Spirit Guardians: Wisdom save, 3d8 radiant (good or neutral caster) or necrotic (evil caster), half on a success, +1d8 for each slot level above 3rd
SRD 5.1, Spike Growth: 2d4 piercing for every 5 feet a creature travels in the area; no saving throw
SRD 5.1, Web: webs burning away deal 2d4 fire to a creature that starts its turn in the fire; the Dexterity save is for being restrained, so none is recorded
SRD 5.1, Earthquake: a creature near a collapsing structure takes 5d6 bludgeoning on a failed Dexterity save and is buried; the save is a later-turn effect, so none is recorded
SRD 5.1, Teleport: a mishap deals 3d10 force damage to each traveller; no saving throw

SRD 5.1, Glyph of Warding: explosive runes deal 5d8 of the chosen acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage, +1d8 for each slot level above 3rd; the Dexterity save happens when the glyph triggers, not at cast, so none is recorded
SRD 5.1, Call Lightning: each creature within 5 feet of the bolt's point makes a Dexterity save, 3d10 lightning on a failure and half on a success (the snapshot has the dice and no saving throw)
SRD 5.1, Disintegrate: 10d6 + 40 force, +3d6 for each slot level above 6th
SRD 5.1, Freezing Sphere: 10d6 cold, +1d6 for each slot level above 6th
SRD 5.1, Phantasmal Killer: 4d10 psychic, +1d10 for each slot level above 4th
SRD 5.1, Wall of Fire: 5d8 fire, +1d8 for each slot level above 4th

SRD 5.1, Flame Strike: 4d6 fire and 4d6 radiant, and from a 6th-level slot the fire damage or the radiant damage (the caster's choice) grows by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th; each type's table is its dice when the caster picks it, the other type staying at 4d6 (the snapshot has the unparsable "4d6 OR 5d6")

subclass_corrections.source: SRD 5.1, Life Domain Spells: at 7th level a cleric always has death ward and guardian of faith (the snapshot lacks guardian of faith)

expanded_list_corrections.source: SRD 5.1, The Fiend, Expanded Spell List: the patron's spells are added to the warlock spell list, to choose from when the warlock learns a spell; they are not given and not always prepared (the snapshot lists them as the subclass's spells)
